embedding_and_retrieval_configuration.chunking: --ast: Python AST-aware; fixed-size chunking for other supported text; one chunk per commit

database.postgresql_version: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg12+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit

metric_definitions.ground_truth: 68 unique query/source labels across 50 queries; the 70 label_evidence entries are evidence annotations and duplicate source annotations collapse per the evaluator's set semantics.
metric_definitions.projection: Top-k chunks are projected in retrieval order to unique first-seen source ranks; later chunks from the same source add no additional relevance gain.
metric_definitions.recall_at_5: Unique relevant sources in projected top-k divided by unique relevant sources for that query.
metric_definitions.precision_at_5: Relevant unique projected source ranks divided by K; denominator remains K when duplicate chunks leave fewer unique sources.
metric_definitions.mrr: Reciprocal rank of the first relevant source in projected order.
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_5: Binary gain per unique projected source, normalized against up to min(K, number of relevant sources).
metric_definitions.retrieval_latency_ms: vector_search's timer includes query embedding, database retrieval, and result conversion; excludes model initialization, warm-up, session/setup, database/container startup, and ingestion.
metric_definitions.p95: Nearest-rank p95 (sorted index ceil(0.95*n)-1), matching the existing evaluator convention.

run_policy: one ingest, one warm-up, each benchmark query executed once in frozen file order; no retries or re-ingestion
